EHAM.notes: Amsterdam Schiphol (EHAM), Netherlands, EUR. AVIAVIP Amsterdam handling quotation (date not shown, valid to 14 Dec 2026; entered as 14 Nov 2026 by user decision; Bombardier Global 6500, GLEX, MTOW 45 t, noise cat S3, NOx 5.568; private; 3 days parking; 1 pax): basic handling 1,630 (flight dispatch except computer flight plan, pax and crew welcome, luggage loading / unloading and transport to FBO, chocking, crew and pax transport to terminal); airport charges 2,186.88 (lump sum, no breakdown); admin fee 15% 328.03 (on airport charges; also 15% disbursement on third-party services); total 4,144.92 excl. VAT 21% (870.43; 5,015.35 incl.). Surcharges: weekend / holiday 815 (50% of basic handling), out of office fee 23:00–07:00 815. FBO services: towing up to 55 t 70 (turnaround towing included), above 55 t 1,560; GPU 95 per 15 min; conveyor belt 225; stairs 240 (not entered by user decision); lavatory 120; potable water 120; arranging ramp access 100 per occasion; ramp transport over 15 pax 100; fuel 32, catering 37, hotel 35 arrangement, dish washing 32 per box, storage 32 per item, hot water 7 / coffee 10 per litre, ice 5 per kg (not entered); cleaning 3rd party. FBO hours 07:00–23:00 LT daily; GA arrivals and departures 07:00–23:00 LT only, no night operations. USER DECISIONS (16 Nov 2026): single handler AVIAVIP; handling and airport fees lump sum only in GLEX (breakdown to be requested or split from Schiphol tariff); towing, GPU, lavatory, water, conveyor in basket in all groups; ramp access and ramp transport as tick rows; admin 15% on airport fees; weekend and out-of-office as flat 815; not verified (quote). JET AVIATION Amsterdam (Schiphol Oost) proforma quotation (14 Nov 2026 13:08Z; T7-ELL Global 6000, MTOW 44,452 kg billed 45 t; OMDW–EHAM 16 Nov 2026 08:00 LT, EHAM–OMDW 20 Nov 2026 22:00 LT; 1 + 1 pax): standard aircraft handling (MTOW 35,001–45,001 kg) 1,075, aircraft turnaround 85; landing fee 4.99 per ton (min 35 t, noise cat AMS S5, min 174.65) 224.55 and take-off fee 224.55, NOx 4.00 × 5.57 on each = 22.28, temporary discount daytime −50% on landing and on take-off (−112.28 each); parking 3.77 per ton-day × 225 (45 t × 5 days) = 848.25; governmental aviation tax 30.25 per pax (VAT out of scope), occupation surcharge 500, passenger service charge 22.44 per departing pax, insulation levy 43.60, PRM levy 2.41, security service charge 21.37 per departing pax (airport fees subtotal 1,737.42); disbursement 15% 260.61; LAV service 170, non-potable water 165, 28V / 115V GPU 310 per hour (min 310), administration fee 35 (all MTOW < 70 t); total 3,838.03 excl. VAT 21% (799.65; 4,637.68 incl.). USER DECISIONS (16 Nov 2026): handler JET AVIATION; handling and turnaround only in GLEX; landing + take-off one row at full rate (min 35 t) in all groups, temporary daytime −50% discount as ticked row (default on); NOx only in GLEX; parking per started 24 h in all groups; pax charges as separate rows as on proforma; occupation surcharge and insulation levy per flight; disbursement 15% on airport fees; GPU, lavatory, water, admin in all groups; AviaVIP keeps its lump sum until breakdown (Jet airport rows empty for AviaVIP). USER DECISION (16 Nov 2026): GLEX stays at 46 t; green and ticked as the Jet Aviation proforma matches. Types from ops system: Jet Aviation and AviaVIP FBO. JET AVIATION invoice 21 Nov 2026 (T7-ELL, EDDB–EHAM 19 Nov, EHAM–OMDW 20 Nov 2026, 0 + 3 pax, total 5,719.34 excl. VAT) confirms all handling, airport and service prices; daytime discount −50% also applied to the 22:40 departure. Additional charges on the invoice: copies / prints / flight documents above 10 pages 0.75 per sheet (EHAM contract discount below 1,000 occ), dishwash 85 per occ, ice 15 per kg, laundry and catering + 15% (not entered).

HAAB.notes: Addis Ababa (Bole), USD. Sources: AEROTRADE proforma C/q 023/26 (19.08.2026, USD); FCG OPS Quote 125746 (21.08.2026, EUR, separate per type; GLEX quote for GL5T group). No invoice. FCG prices in EUR, converted to USD at 1.1215 (ECB 20 Oct 2026); recalculate when rate is updated. EUR originals: handling 738.94 (ALX1·KBI, OWN) / 1,045.33 (FLH) / 1,450.85 (ALEX, ELL) / 2,353.80 (AFZ); landing 261.33 / 279.36 / 297.38 (FLH) / 306.39 (ALEX, ELL) / 310.90 (AFZ); lighting 225.29 (≤40 t) / 230.69; parking 108.14 per day; aircraft security 180.23 per 24 h; terminal pax 58.57 and pax tax 31.54 per departing pax; navigation 178.43 (estimated); CAA charge 36.05; supervision 225.29; coordination & administration 400; landing permit 90 (+50% for urgent request/correction); communication 40; bank 50. Airport fees from FCG quotes, same at both handlers (user decision). AeroTrade ECAA landing fee 40 USD = CAA Charge (higher 40.43). Parking and aircraft security every started 24 h, no free time (not stated in quote; to be rechecked). Lighting only for night operations: 18:00–06:00 local (UTC+3) each landing and take-off (window assumed). FCG disbursement 11%: on basic handling + airport fees (excl. coordination, supervision, permit, communication, bank); minimum 30 EUR. Included in FCG handling: water, lavatory, cabin cleaning, garbage, chocks, baggage/cargo, tow tractor, conveyor belt, high loader, stairs, GPU 1 h, ASU 1 h, pushback once (no price for further use). FCG night surcharge 'applicable', no rate — not entered. AEROTRADE: basic GH fee 15–25 t 802.50 / 25–35 t 1,158 / 35–50 t 1,605 / 50–75 t 2,611.50; supervision 120. Included: passenger and ramp service, pax and crew transfer within apron, 1 pushback, stairs, toilet, GPU 1 h; GPU after first hour 200 per hour (with GPU hours box). ASU 180, ACU 350 per hour (each 15 min part after first hour), lounge (Cloud Nine / Shaba Miles) 30 per pax first 4 h, then 10 per pax per hour. Coordination service 84 per type per hour (if basic not taken; tick, qty = hours). Landing permit not charged if AeroTrade does supervision and disbursement (Free). Disbursement rate not stated (empty). Wheelchair not entered. KRIMSON (K2 Aerokom Ltd; local handler ICAS – International Cargo and Aviation Services), USD. Source: invoice K2_FAL_026_013 (07 Sep 2026; T7-AFP GLF5 41.05 t, OMAD–HAAB–OMAD, 20 Aug 2026, 10:24–11:36, 12 departing pax), ICAS invoice 4701 and Ethiopian Airports invoice 10010090 (landing 240.24, terminal 60, embarkation 12 × 30, arr/dep charge 12 × 2, CUTE 12 × 1.50; parking, security and lighting 0 for 72 min stay; total 703). Handling (ICAS) 15–25 t 802.50 (OWN), 25–35 t 1,158 (FLH), 35–50 t 1,605 (ALEX and ELL group); other groups as invoices arrive. Supervision by aircraft group: OWN 250, FLH 300, ALEX and ELL group 350 (in basket, no disbursement; other groups as invoices arrive), flight plan filing 50 (in basket, no disbursement), crew bus 50 and crew assistance 50 tick. Local handler arrangement fee = ICAS 10% on airport fees; entered as 10.8% to cover Krimson disbursement too. Krimson disbursement 8%: on ICAS items and catering; excl. supervision, crew assistance and flight plan. NISS (security authority) 3 per departing pax and per aircraft by weight band (probably fixed in Birr, USD at day rate): ALX1·KBI, OWN, FLH 4.50; ALEX group, ELL and AFZ 6.25 (safe side; ALEX group A6-AFE 45.1 t, band limit between 41–48.8 t unknown).
